title: peucedanum angustifolium
intro: Peucedanum angustifolium, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Masterwort, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which are attributed to its health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, carminative, and expectorant, making it useful in the treatment of various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Peucedanum angustifolium include volatile oils, flavonoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
